text: Have you heard about the new facial recognition technology at our school?
Yes, I have. We won't need student ID cards anymore. The cameras will scan our faces.
Do you think it's a good idea?
Definitely. It's faster and more secure.
But what about privacy? I'm worried about who will have access to our data.
The school says the data is encrypted and safe.
Technology is changing everything. I read that scientists are developing biometric sensors to monitor our health.
Yes, those sensors can warn us before we get sick. Science and technology are really improving our lives.
